finalText:
Green: 625/625, exit 0.

**What was broken:** exactly 3 of 625 cases failed, all in `order totals`:

```
FAIL 433  total 12000c, 15% off, tax 0.0825
FAIL 434  total 8650c,  20% off, tax 0.05
FAIL 435  total 33400c, 10% off, tax 0.2
```

**Root cause** — `src/pricing.js:39` `orderTotal` applied tax to the *pre-discount* base:

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
const tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate);   // <- cents, not discounted
return discounted + tax;
```

Its own doc comment says tax is charged on what the customer actually pays, so this contradicted the documented rule as well as `cases.js:89`. It stayed hidden because 66 of the 69 order-total rows have either a zero discount or a zero tax, and in both of those degenerate cases the wrong formula gives the right answer. Only the three rows with *both* non-zero could expose it — e.g. 12000c at 15% off with 8.25% tax returned 11190 instead of 11042 (+148).

**Fix** (one line, `src/pricing.js:39`):

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

This also routes the tax through `applyTax`, matching the spec's round-then-tax-then-round sequencing. No other file changed; the other eight suites were already passing and still are.
